name: create_kms_issuer
description:
Create a KMS issuer with server-generated signing keys for the selected team. Configure its name, signing algorithm, claims schema, and initial policy. Private-key import is unavailable through MCP.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

algorithm.description: The signing algorithm to use for the issuer.

claimsSchema.description: A JSON Schema used to validate the resolved token claims when signing tokens for this issuer.

environments.description: The environments for the project grant policy. Each entry is a system environment (production, preview, development) or a custom environment ID (env_...).

projectId.description: The project ID for the project grant policy.

teamId.description: The team ID for the project grant policy.

tokenClaims.description: The claims that KMS should include in signed JWTs for this policy.

clientId.description: The Connex client ID for the Connex grant policy.

tokenClaims.description: The claims that KMS should include in signed JWTs for this policy.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
